subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the GDP of two countries P and Q in different five years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f52fd3afd6880e456cb9f1b10fd30914784fd147a37bb702a1acaaf7c86117a9.png] 

L1 = The total GDP of country P in all the 5 years.

L2 = The total GDP of country Q in all the 5 years.

What is the value of (L2 - L1)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

L1 = The total GDP of country P in all 5 years.

L1 = 225 + 250 + 200 + 125 + 100 = 900

L2 = The total GDP of country Q in all 5 years.

L2 = 335 + 350 + 175 + 135 + 145 = 1140

L2 - L1 = 1140 - 900 = 240

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
